channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Canola industry pumped about 45Z ruling in U.S.
item.description: Canada’s canola sector is pleased with the new 45Z guidance published by U.S. Treasury.

item.title: Alberta research centre closure called ‘catastrophe’
item.description: The cattle industry is mourning the loss of Agriculture Canada’s research centre in Lacombe, Alta., part of sweeping cuts to the department that were announced late last month.

item.title: Bunge forecasts 2026 profit below estimates on macroeconomic uncertainty
item.description: Bunge Global on Wednesday reported a 2026 profit outlook below analysts’ expectations.

item.title: Former U.S. agriculture officials, top Republican senator warn of farm country trouble
item.description: The chair of the U.S. Senate’s agriculture committee warned on Tuesday that farmers were suffering heavy losses, while more than two dozen former industry leaders sounded the alarm about the risk of a “widespread collapse of American agriculture” ahead of a $12 billion government bailout expected to reach growers this month.

item.title: Manitoba research centre part of Agriculture Canada cuts
item.description: The closure of seven federal research facilities throughout the country, including the research centre in Portage la Prairie, will be a blow, and producers are still not sure what to make of it.

item.title: Russia targets global seed, farming technology market
item.description: Russia, the world’s largest wheat exporter, plans to target global markets with its seeds and technologies to counter an expected shrinking of grain exports caused by increased production in other countries.

item.title: Global acceptance grows for gene edited crops
item.description: More and more countries have decided that gene edited crops will be treated the same as conventional plant breeding

item.title: Court finds Sunterra liable to U.S. lender
item.description: An Alberta court has ruled that Sunterra owes Compeer Financial $35 million after undertaking fraudulent behaviour in its U.S. operations.

item.title: Trump, Xi discuss Taiwan and soybeans in call aimed at easing China, U.S. relations
item.description: China is considering buying more U.S.-farmed soybeans, President Donald Trump said after what he called “very positive” talks with President Xi Jinping on Wednesday, even as Beijing warned Washington about arms sales to Taiwan.

item.title: CBOT Weekly: Additional soybean purchases strengthen U.S. soy
item.description: There were good gains for the Chicago soy complex during the week ended Feb. 4, due to positive news that Wednesday.
